effect_if_accepted: P2-2 exact-Wilson pure-GGA molecular transfer and the bounded NH3 integration bridge are accepted, authorizing P2-3 performance and memory qualification. Acceptance does not authorize a long trajectory, spectrum, larger basis, reduced-action production dynamics, or a physical application campaign.
limitations: The immutable base analyzer proposed failure because it compared semantic grid fingerprints and because the coarse exact-bare current residual exceeded its threshold by 9.14%; the separate authenticated supplement corrects the grid comparison and resolves the current check without overwriting the base result.
One timestep halving identifies second-order bare-trajectory time error as the dominant current discrepancy, but it is not a multi-level convergence-order claim for either propagator.
The NH3 pulse is a short numerical bridge, not a resonant pulse, absorption calculation, kick, long-time trajectory, or spectrum.
The exact-bare reduction check is at zero magnetic field and does not establish interchangeability of distinct finite-field actions.

No diffuse or larger-basis ladder, grid ladder, auxiliary-basis ladder, reduced P0/E1 dynamics, general magnetic envelope, spatially nonuniform source, EELS potential, pseudopotential, hybrid functional, moving nucleus, or periodic system is qualified.
P2-3 may optimize only mathematically identical implementation paths and may not weaken any accepted physics or numerical tolerance.
Timings and peak memory are machine-specific qualification measurements, not production guarantees.
